title: DMB work-file frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter for memory-bank/tasks/work/*.md files — in-flight topic scratchpads.

title.description: Human-readable title. Can differ from the filename slug.

status.description: Lifecycle stage of this work item.

branch.description: Git branch name. Set when work begins. Enables PR-linking automation.

pr.description: PR number. Typically set by automation when a PR opens.

updated.description: Last-updated date (YYYY-MM-DD). Keep fresh for staleness detection.
